svg.title: Gemini 4 Argon officially available: What developers should check during the introductory pricing period
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Gemini 4 Argon officially available: What developers
should check during the introductory pricing period
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-16
1 Where can you use it?
The Google Developers Blog says you can start
developing immediately on a paid Gemini API
plan.
2 Pricing is divided into two stages
Google presented introductory prices of $2 per 1
million input tokens and $10 per 1 million
output tokens.
3 Applying it to our service
As an example, let’s assume a service uses 100
million input tokens and 10 million output
tokens per month.
4 Three criteria for deciding whether
to switch
First, look at the cost per task rather than the
price per token.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
